note: Beginner-facing explainers for deck formats, keyed by lowercased rule type. Shown when the legality badge is tapped. FormatGlossary.swift appends a Legal / Not-Legal sentence, so these describe only the format itself. Definitions are original paraphrases. Unknown formats fall back to a generic line in code.

standard.label: Standard
standard.definition: Magic's core rotating format. Only sets from roughly the last two to three years are legal, so the card pool stays fresh. Decks are a minimum of 60 cards with up to four copies of any card other than basic lands.

pioneer.label: Pioneer
pioneer.definition: A non-rotating format using cards from Return to Ravnica (2012) onward. Minimum 60 cards, up to four copies of each card.

modern.label: Modern
modern.definition: A large non-rotating format with cards from Eighth Edition and Mirrodin (2003) onward. Minimum 60 cards, up to four copies of each card.

legacy.label: Legacy
legacy.definition: A format that uses nearly every card ever printed, governed by a banned list. Minimum 60 cards, up to four copies of each card.

vintage.label: Vintage
vintage.definition: Magic's most powerful format — almost every card is legal. A short banned list and a 'restricted' list (cards limited to a single copy) keep it in check. Minimum 60 cards.

pauper.label: Pauper
pauper.definition: A format where only cards printed at common rarity are legal. Minimum 60 cards, up to four copies of each card.

commander.label: Commander
commander.definition: A singleton, usually-multiplayer format. You pick a legendary creature as your commander, then build a 100-card deck where every other card is a single copy and matches your commander's colour identity.

brawl.label: Brawl
brawl.definition: A singleton format like Commander but limited to Standard-legal cards. A 60-card deck led by a legendary creature or planeswalker, built to that leader's colour identity.

oathbreaker.label: Oathbreaker
oathbreaker.definition: A singleton format led by a planeswalker plus a chosen 'signature spell'. 60-card decks are built to the planeswalker's colour identity.

tiny leaders.label: Tiny Leaders
tiny leaders.definition: A singleton format led by a legendary creature, with 50-card decks limited to cards of mana value 3 or less.

pauper commander.label: Pauper Commander
pauper commander.definition: Commander restricted to commons, with an uncommon legendary creature as the commander. A 100-card singleton deck built to the commander's colour identity.

historic.label: Historic
historic.definition: A non-rotating MTG Arena format spanning cards from across Arena's history, including some digital-only cards.

alchemy.label: Alchemy
alchemy.definition: A rotating MTG Arena format that adds digital-only and rebalanced (A-) cards on top of the Standard card pool.
